description.en: PGxLOD groups data related to pharmacogenomics (PGx) from various sources such as PharmGKB, DrugBank, ClinVar, DisGeNET, but also the scientific literature. Central elements of PGxLOD are pharmacogenomic relationships, which are n-ary relationships linking drugs, genetic factors and drug-response phenotypes. Such relationships state the atomic elements of knowledge in PGx, i.e., a patient with a specified genetic factor and being treated with a specified drug is likely to experience the specified drug-response phenotypes (such as an adverse effect, no effect, etc.). PGxLOD is developed in the ANR PractiKPharma project (http://practikpharma.loria.fr/).

example.title: Example of a pharmacogenomic relationship
example.description: Relationship extracted from the biomedical literature and stating that mithramycin A decreases the transcription of xiap gene.
